remaining_gaps: First end not established, only bounded. Sec. 4(b) ends the Commission on October 1, 1982 or 60 days after it submits its final report, whichever is earlier, so the end is not later than 1982-10-01 and earlier if the final report was submitted before 1982-08-02. No held source dates the Commission's final report or shows that it terminated on October 1, 1982 (searches of the held texts for the Commission name return only EO 12323, EO 12366 and EO 12399). A dated final report, or a source showing that no earlier report was submitted, is needed. Formal disposition is EO 12399 sec. 4(h), effective December 31, 1982 (48 FR 379-380), which recites only that revoked committees 'have terminated or whose work is completed' without a date, so it is not the first end under the 2026-10-28 ruling. The EO 12366 amendment of sec. 1(b) (membership 11 to 12, 1982-05-25) is held as FR text (EO_12366.txt); the earlier claim's APP-mirror copy of it was custody_record_only.
